theme: An open day, girls back home
greeting: The whole day is open, Dan — no meetings on the calendar, just a few overdue bookings and the board search to put the hours against.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority Todoist task to reserve a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is a month past due — it's flagged as the one most likely to bite, since holiday inventory in that market sells out.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break call
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by-Sep-30, book-by-Oct-15 task for the 21-day December trip with all four girls is past both dates; holiday inventory for six only gets thinner from here.

flagged.title: Board-search recruiter is waiting on you
flagged.detail: A partner in a CEO & board-director search practice has a LinkedIn message still awaiting your reply — squarely relevant to the board search.

flagged.title: Unanswered LinkedIn message from Hans-Kristian
flagged.detail: A contact named Hans-Kristian messaged you on LinkedIn and the thread is still unanswered.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail promos, a LinkedIn job alert, and a St. Pete local newsletter.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Autumn apples are at their peak, and a free-form galette lets their sweetness and the first cool air do the work.

tasks.title: Place the Portland house order (bedframe, soap holder)
Call the dermatologist for Mike's appointment

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar to anchor the day — the hours are yours to spend where they matter.
An open stretch with no meetings pulling at it; good conditions for the work that needs a clear head.
The girls are back in the house — a slower, from-scratch dinner suits the first real autumn chill.
